_labeling: Legitimate least-privilege footprint. Notes are stored as JSON files under ./notes_data (the data_dir), which is hard-coded at server construction and never appears as a tool parameter.

create_note.notes: Writes a new <id>.json note file; does not read.

search_notes.notes: Globs and reads all note files in notes_data.

read_note.notes: Reads a single note file by id.
